findings.issue: The Pokémon-id→species resolution pipeline (extract ids ≤10000, dedupe, sort, map through speciesIndex) is duplicated across moves, types and abilities pages with slight variations
findings.suggestion: Add a shared helper in lib/data.ts, e.g. resolveSpecies(pokemonRefs, extra) returning SpeciesRef[], so exclusion rules and mapping change in one place

findings.issue: TypeBadge.astro exists but is bypassed; the same <a class="type-badge" data-type=…> markup is hand-inlined at pokemon:204, pokemon:337, types/[name].astro:79 and moves/[name].astro:72
findings.suggestion: Use the TypeBadge component everywhere (pass label), so badge markup and fallback behaviour change in one file

findings.issue: Seven hand-rolled promise-memoization blocks with identical reset-on-error boilerplate (lines 40, 58, 72, 90, 109, 121, 183)
findings.suggestion: Extract a memoize(key, factory) helper; changing cache policy (TTL, eviction) then touches one place

findings.issue: The not-found try/catch + Astro.response.status = 404 pattern is duplicated in all four [name].astro pages
findings.suggestion: Extract a fetchDetail(name, resource) helper that returns { data, notFound } or sets the response status

findings.issue: The 'omit empty/default query params' rule is implemented twice — server pageHref (index.astro:33-40) and client navigate — and must be kept in sync manually
findings.suggestion: Have the client script reuse a single shared param-serialization helper (e.g. a small exported module imported by both)

findings.issue: Dex number formatting re-inlined (#${String(species.id).padStart(4, '0')}) although dexNumber() exists in lib/pokeapi.ts:113
TypeInfo/GenerationInfo mapping duplicated between getTypes/getGenerations and getHomeIndex
findings.suggestion: Derive getTypes()/getGenerations() from the same mapping functions used by getHomeIndex

findings.issue: Detail pages and lib functions operate on any-typed API payloads, weakening the typed seam data.ts establishes with SpeciesRef/TypeInfo
findings.suggestion: Add minimal interfaces for the resources pages consume (Move, Ability, TypeDetail) so refactors are type-checked

findings.issue: Card sprite URL is derived from a hardcoded /media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png pattern rather than the API-provided sprites.front_default
findings.suggestion: Spec-sanctioned and avoids 1000+ fetches, but document the assumption next to spriteUrl, or make the pattern a named constant

summary: A small, cleanly layered Astro 7 app that is easy to delete from and mostly easy to fix: every Pokémon card renders through one component backed by one URL helper, and the API base URL lives in a single module. The main editability debt is copy-paste rather than tangle — the Pokémon-id→species pipeline, the detail-page shape, badge markup and memoization boilerplate are each duplicated three to seven times. Extending the list pages (sorting, an Items section, cache policy changes) means editing or cloning several near-identical blocks.
